en-US.title: Trim Workout
en-US.subtitle: Log sets. Follow a plan
en-US.description:
Trim is a plan-first iPhone workout logger. Build a plan of training days, log sets in a table, and reuse last time’s weights.

KEY FEATURES:
• Create a plan with multiple training days
• Set table with previous values, kg/lbs, and a rest timer
• Custom exercises when the catalog doesn’t have yours
• History of completed sessions on this iPhone

Trim stays on your iPhone. No account.

Trim Pro is optional: extra plans, full history, and stats. Download Trim and log your next session in seconds.
en-US.releaseNotes: First release: plans, set-table logging, rest timer, history, and Trim Pro.
